description: Reads an NWB/HDF5 file with h5py, locates stimulus and response TimeSeries for sweeps 19–24, computes sampling and signal metrics, and returns the required JSON-serializable structure. The implementation is robust to NWB1/NWB2 layout variations by scanning for TimeSeries under /stimulus and /acquisition, uses dataset conversion/offset attributes, decodes stored units, converts to pA/mV for computations, detects the main negative pulse as the longest contiguous run below the median by ≥1e-6 pA, and computes onset/duration/amplitude and voltage deflection using sample-count windows. Only the specified file is read; no external files or tools are used.
